content.text: === find a real project slug from Mongo ===

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo '=== find a real project slug from Mongo ==='; docker exec workspace-mongo-1 mongosh --quiet --eval 'db.getSiblingDB("urban_kit").projects.find({}, {slug:1,title:1}).limit(5).forEach(d=>print(d.slug+" | "+d.title))' 2>&1 | head
